definitions.explanation: The various tasks involved in maintaining a household, such as cooking, cleaning, laundry, and other domestic duties.

examples.japanese: {夫婦|ふうふ}で{家事|かじ}を{分担|ぶんたん}している。
{仕事|しごと}と{育児|いくじ}と{家事|かじ}を{両立|りょうりつ}させるのは{簡単|かんたん}ではない。
examples.english: Balancing work, childcare, and housework is not easy.

notes:
{家事|かじ} combines {家|か} (house, home) and {事|じ} (matter, task).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家事|かじ}をする (to do housework)
- {家事|かじ}を{手伝|てつだ}う (to help with housework)
- {家事|かじ}を{分担|ぶんたん}する (to share housework)
- {家事|かじ}{代行|だいこう} (housekeeping service)
- {家事|かじ}{育児|いくじ} (housework and childcare)

USAGE:
{家事|かじ} is the standard word for housework in general. It encompasses {料理|りょうり} (cooking), {掃除|そうじ} (cleaning), {洗濯|せんたく} (laundry), and other domestic tasks. Note the homophone {火事|かじ} (fire, conflagration), which has completely different kanji and meaning.
